name: print-social-gradient-flower-vector-tutorial-steps
title: Gradient Flower Illustration Tutorial
whatItIs: A six-step tutorial on charcoal showing how a glowing orange-red flower is built: half hexagon, corner radius, nested scaled copies, masked blur, leaf shapes, and the finished flower with vines.
whatItMeans: Big faint step numbers and simple shapes make craft approachable. The glowing finished piece rewards the reader.
techniques: Oversized ghost numerals as step markers
Layout of six equal cells with progressive complexity
Parameter labels (radius, colors, blur) under each step
Finished result at full saturation as the payoff

vocabulary.definition: A large faded number marking each stage of a process.
A blur limited to a shape to create soft glowing color.
The final polished result shown last and most vividly.
